task: Normalize email, search for an existing record, then update or create using an idempotency or uniqueness mechanism.
acceptance: Repeated input results in one record, including concurrent retries.
challenge: Preserve fields absent from the update request.
review_risk: Search then create alone is not concurrency safe

controls.approval: bind to exact draft when action requires review
controls.idempotency: persistent stable-key handling required for real side effects
controls.logs: no secrets or unnecessary personal data
